name: a-space-dot-magnifies-under-the-cursor
description: The magnification lives in a module the sidebar has to install on every rebuilt dots bar, so the unit suite cannot say whether production wires it at all. Puts the pointer over a dot through a real mousemove on the bar and reads which dot wears the chip and what it says.

actions.expression: (() => { const bar = document.querySelector('.spacedots'); const target = bar.querySelector('.sdot[data-space-index="1"]'); if (!target) return 'no-dot'; const box = target.getBoundingClientRect(); bar.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {bubbles: true, clientX: box.left + box.width / 2, clientY: box.top + box.height / 2})); const chip = bar.querySelector('.sdot.mag'); return chip === target ? 'chip=' + chip.querySelector('.d').textContent : 'wrong-dot'; })()

(() => { const chip = document.querySelector('.spacedots .sdot.mag'); if (!chip) return 'no-chip'; const after = chip.nextElementSibling; if (!after) return 'no-neighbour'; const t = getComputedStyle(after).transform; return t && t !== 'none' ? 'shoved' : 'still'; })()
(() => { const bar = document.querySelector('.spacedots'); bar.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseleave', {bubbles: true})); return String(bar.querySelectorAll('.sdot.mag').length); })()

assertions.desc: setup: nothing is magnified before the pointer arrives
The dot under the cursor wears the chip and shows the space initial
The dot after it slides out of the way
The bar settles back when the cursor leaves
